title: Filtration of a constructible sheaf by extensions by zero of lisse sheaves
statement:
Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, $\Lambda=E$ or $\Qlb$, and $F\in\Cons(X,\Lambda)$. Let
$S_1,\dots,S_m$ be a stratification adapted to $F$, ordered as in
[det-lem-coefficient-heart-common-stratification] (1), so that $V_k=S_1\cup\dots\cup S_k$ is
open, with open immersions $v_k\colon V_k\hookrightarrow X$, and let $a_k\colon S_k\hookrightarrow X$.
Put $F_k=v_{k!}v_k^*F\subseteq F$. Then
$$
0=F_0\subseteq F_1\subseteq\dots\subseteq F_m=F,\qquad F_k/F_{k-1}\cong a_{k!}(F|_{S_k}),
$$
and each $F|_{S_k}$ is lisse.
Here $V_0=\varnothing$, and lisse means locally free of finite rank for the pro-étale topology. The category $\Cons(X,\Lambda)$ is the category of constructible $\Lambda_X$-modules of [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. For a locally closed immersion $a\colon S\hookrightarrow X$, write $a=i\circ u$, where $u\colon S\hookrightarrow\overline S$ is open and $i\colon\overline S\hookrightarrow X$ is closed, and define $a_!=i_*u_!$. The inclusions in the filtration need not be strict.

proof.text: Noetherian open prefixes and their open intersections are Noetherian and quasi-separated, so all open immersions required by the successor theorem are quasi-compact and quasi-separated. The specified condensed-coefficient functors already include the coefficient pullback identifications. The unit-route coefficient and heart-closure imports remain present.

source.place: First paragraph: hypotheses for localization and the nested-open theorem.

proof.text: The proved private monic-counit and empty-module lemmas in the integral-gluing module apply to any commutative condensed ring. They show that every actual open counit is monic, that the empty prefix has zero image, and that the full prefix has top image. The last prefix inclusion is an isomorphism because its image is the whole scheme.

source.place: First paragraph: monic counits, nesting and endpoints.

proof.text: The difference of consecutive prefixes is exactly the given stratum, by the prefix equations and pairwise disjointness. Lift its immersion into the larger open; it is an immersion with closed image, hence closed. Apply [lem-sfb-open-filtration-successor] to obtain a natural nesting map, its actual counit identity, and its natural cokernel. Evaluate at F, use [lem-sfb-image-subobject-of-monomorphism] and [lem-sfb-subobject-inclusion-cokernel], and use preservation of cokernels by evaluation. This gives the quotient as the closed extension inside the larger prefix followed by open extension to X.

source.place: Second paragraph: localization quotient and comparison with the actual subobject inclusion.

proof.text: Compare this closed-then-open extension N with the prescribed closure factorization using the existing earlier support interfaces. For a map missing the stratum, its pullback into the larger open factors through the open complement of the closed stratum. Apply openRestrictionPushforwardZero from the condensed recollement module, pullback composition, and open base change to show the restriction of N is zero. The existing open unit and closed counit identify its restriction to the stratum with M. Apply abelian_closed_support to the forgotten module on X, then the existing moduleUnitOfAbelian transport, to obtain the invertible closed-support unit for the closure. Inside the closure, apply the existing abelian_open_supported_counit and essential-image transport for module open extension to obtain its invertible open counit. Composing these maps and pullback composition gives N isomorphic to the specified open-then-closed extension. No duplicate module-support wrapper is declared.

source.place: Second paragraph: comparison of the two locally closed factorizations.

proof.text: Apply [new-det-lem-coefficient-heart-common-stratification-lisse] to R and its identity refinement. The adapted finite constant local model on each stratum therefore gives exactly the required lisse restriction.

source.place: Final sentence: lisseness on the adapted strata.

proof_origin.place: D2 stage-3 repaired proof: actual condensed open counits, existing natural open successor and image-subobject cokernel comparison; existing earlier abelian support and module-transport interfaces for the closure comparison, with four duplicate private wrappers removed; identity-refinement lisseness.
